summary: Voz-AI is an AI-powered voice assistant that allows customers to ask questions naturally and receive real-time responses. Using Twilio, Ollama (LLaMA 3.1), Flask, and RAG, it understands queries, retrieves relevant data, and delivers dynamic answers. This project won Runner-Up at AIQoD Hackathon 202
